android.desc:
Whether it's a late night party or it's raining, a SafeCar driver is ready to get you and your buddies there without a hassle. With up to 4 passengers in one car, order at any time of the day.

SafeBoda rides are safe and affordable for everyone. We add value to customers and drivers with additional financial services, such as payments & on-demand services, to keep the community thriving. 

Stepping out? Trust us to get you there safely and affordably. 

Our driver community undertakes mandatory training on proper road usage, first aid and road safety. A SafeBoda driver is identifiable by their name(s) at the back of the orange reflector jacket and a unique number on the helmet. A SafeCar driver is identified by matching the number plate on your app to that on the car. 

Need to pay utility bills? Pay all your bills with just a few clicks 

You can pay water, electricity, TV and tax bills effortlessly on the SafeBoda app. All you have to do is deposit cashless on your wallet, tap pay bills and follow prompts. 

Running low on airtime or data? Buy more on the app, you can buy airtime or data for you and your friends & family at no extra cost.

Making deliveries? Send parcels safely and quickly. 

Our drivers will move your items from one location to another while you track all the progress through the app.

Go cashless, pay through the app  

Deposit to your SafeBoda Wallet using mobile money/card, with a driver, or at an agent location, and enjoy cashless rides all the way.  

Withdraw money anytime, anywhere  

You can withdraw money to your MTN or Airtel mobile number, bank or with an agent at the most affordable rates. To find an agent, tap the find agent icon on your app, and you will see the agents within your location.

quotes.text:
As a former Lyft engineer of 2.5 years, I love dreaming about how my net worth is increasing every time Uber's CEO makes another catastrophic gaffe. The Lyft numbers continue skyrocketing and things have never looked better for something I now own tons of stock in.

However, if you ask me, the value of today's ride sharing networks are in the human driver network only. These companies spend tons of effort corralling humans into their apps in order to have your ass in a seat within just a few minutes.

The technology to create a ride dispatching software platform is extremely easy to crank out. I cranked one out from scratch a few months ago for a company in Africa (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.safeboda.passenger&hl=en) in just 10 days and chronicled it here (https://hackernoon.com/how-building-lyft-helped-me-launch-a-new-ride-share-app-in-10-days-4d73b0ee1e3e)

If/when the tech for driverless comes of age, vehicle manufacturers will be able to quickly produce enough units to satisfy demand, develop an app for very low cost, and crash the value of human powered networks.

If Google releases an app & automated car, I'm going to install it. Same for Tesla. Would I want to use a 3rd party ride aggregator to save $0.50 or have it arrive a minute sooner? Not if I could ride to work in a Tesla for $3.

I say "ridesharing" in double quotes because this whole thing is obviously just taxi 2.0. A ride SHARE would be if someone joined you, as the driver, on a ride …
quotes.title: “Ridesharing” as we know is it going to crash
